# @fyit/crouton-analytics

> Provider-agnostic usage analytics — PostHog default, swappable backend, lean-loop events

AI hint: use when an app or POC needs product-usage analytics (pageviews, funnels, lean-startup validation events). PostHog by default (already wired in this org); swappable to a self-host sink. NOT for CRUD audit — that is crouton-events.

## Composables

- `useCroutonAnalytics`
